title: Wren and the Sigil
author: Casper Zhou
blurb: Emrys Zhou, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
